title: Contact
description: Panoramic Ireland create photography tours and workshops throughout Ireland for everyone
html:
Contact

Dublin / Belfast / Galway / Cork - Ireland

The best way to contact me is by email, see the top bar or use the contact form, I am often photographing in wild and inaccessible places with no phone reception - emails usually come through and I can reply easily during quiet moments.

About Panoramic Ireland

Panoramic Ireland create tours of Northern Ireland, Galway, Wicklow and Dingle with an emphasis on photography. We also run Dublin Photo Tours, comprising photography tuition, courses and tours of Ireland's capital city, Dublin. We're 100% Irish and we want to show you the best landscapes, cityscapes and coastal locations that Ireland has to offer while learning how to make better images.

We have photographed for the biggest names in the world including New York Times, Sunday Times, Easyjet, Ritz-Carlton and many many more so joing us to learn how to make better images - send an email today, Panoramic Ireland are open 365 days.
